description: You are organizing a home food preservation inventory. Read the messy canning notes from /home/ga/Documents/canning_notes.txt and create a proper inventory spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/canning_inventory.xlsx. The spreadsheet should include: Item Name, Date Processed, Quantity Remaining (accounting for items given away), Size, Location, Use By Date (12 months from processing), Days Until Expiry (from Dec 8, 2024), and Priority (URGENT if <60 days). Apply conditional formatting to highlight urgent items and sort by Days Until Expiry ascending.
